Elena (partnerships): Quick note: platform plans to retire the /v1/compat-proxy translation route on 2026-05-15. Need partner outreach + mitigation plan.
Rajat (platform): We'll replace with /v1/generate and a header mapping. Can offer a marketplace-hosted shim for slower partners and a 30-day transparent rewrite window.
Maya (integrations): I'll pull the impacted partner list (marketplace, HW OEMs, SI partners) and tag priorities. Need exact header/param diffs to publish migration docs.
Sam (eng): Technical: compat-proxy did KV-cache prefixing and used the `compat=true` flag. New route keeps cache semantics but removes that flag. We'll add gateway rewrite for transition and provide SDK patches.
Elena (partnerships): Action items: partner email + migration guide, tracked spreadsheet, and rollback playbook. Offer assisted migration slots for top partners.
Rajat (platform): Proposed timeline: announce 2026-04-01, start rewrites 2026-04-15, partner canaries 2026-04-22, full removal 2026-05-15. I'll own the canary dashboard and rollback toggle.
Maya (integrations): Pinged AcmeHW and CloudPartner for canary windows. I'll also include marketplace listing IDs in the tracker.
VendorBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PLT-523 for shim + docs + outreach.
Sam (eng): We'll add smoke tests for cache semantics and provide python/js/go patches. Example quick snippet for partners included in docs.
Elena (partnerships): Next sync Tue 2026-03-30 09:30 PT. Spreadsheet link -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PLT-523 :thumbsup:
